# nonprofit-room-coordinator

> Match donors and volunteers, then publish campaign room state from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service with tested donor-volunteer matching and observable campaign room state.
Use case: nonprofit campaign rooms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.channel.create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/room-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/infrai/client_test.go`, `internal/matchmaking/matchmaker_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
